freeze.authoring: 47 cases written by hand from the ten required categories in the V2.1 brief, before the first scored run. No case was produced by editing a V1/V2 case, and no V1/V2 failure list was consulted while writing them. Expected values and grading keys were fixed in the same pass.

dev_set.purpose: pre-freeze defect shake-out; never reported as generalisation evidence
fixes_prompted_by_dev_set: eval_lib: broaden clarification tokens to polite forms (请您提供/请重新)
extractor: downgrade a task intent to clarify when the utterance has no actionable content
router: a clarifying plan keeps the task type so a later turn can resume it
controller: classify Module B's pre-compute rejections as upstream_rejected
eval_lib: must_not_contain now ignores sentences that reject the token
dev_set.note: These are generic fixes to the pipeline and the grader. None of them encodes a specific case, a shelter id, or an expected value.

freeze.declaration: Scores from this file are reported as measured. If a fix is needed after this point, a new case file (v21b) is created and re-run; this file is never edited and re-scored.

design.label: post-fix regression (V2.3 final)
design.note: Expectations were written before the first run. The case file is hash-locked; failures are reported as measured and are not rescored after fixes. A run with label=post-fix regression measures the same frozen cases after code changes and is NOT a blind score.
